title: Agentic Frameworks & Coordination
description: From a single decision to a coordinated team. Design how agents plan, delegate, remember, and act.
question: How should intelligence work together?
principles: Give every agent a clear task contract.
Prefer predictable workflows until autonomy adds value.

title: Enterprise-Grade Security & Governance
description: Build permission boundaries, protect enterprise knowledge, and make every action accountable.
question: What is this agent allowed to do?
principles: Treat retrieved text and tool output as untrusted inputs.
Keep evidence for every consequential action.

title: Resilience, Reliability & Failure Handling
description: Make failure a designed part of the system. Recover work safely and keep useful service available.
question: What happens when a dependency fails?
principles: Bound work with deadlines and budgets.
Separate transient failures from permanent errors.

title: Advanced RAG & Data Architecture
description: Connect agents to relevant, current, authorized knowledge. Design retrieval you can evaluate.
question: Which evidence should the model trust?
principles: Treat freshness and context selection as design decisions.

title: Model Optimization, Deployment & Infrastructure
description: Balance quality, latency, capacity, and cost. Turn model capabilities into dependable services.
question: How does the system behave at scale?
principles: Measure quality before optimizing serving cost.
Test tail latency with representative traffic.
Version models, prompts, and evaluation evidence together.
